function.name: Render_BuildActorSpritePayload
behavior: Reads the actor's animation frame record and iterates its sub-sprite entries.
Copies each sub-sprite's tile/position words into the 14-byte renderer payload at the output pointer.
Combines the actor sprite attribute and horizontal state into the payload attribute words.
Advances the output pointer and increments the payload count at 0x00FFEFEE.

conclusion: AnimationVM frame changes build the actor sprite payload consumed by the later VDP submission stage; the payload builder is separate from both the animation command interpreter and sprite-attribute-list builder.
